items.title: Roswell Rudd interviewed by Monk Rowe, Ellenville, New York, June 23, 1998
items.q: that would have been in November of 1997 with Elton Dean’s New Sense Band

ctx.x: Do you have particular favorite recordings of yourself?

I think I finally made one pretty good solo, I just want to mention, and that would have been in November of 1997 with Elton Dean’s New Sense Band, which is a band that has a core of three trombones, and then there’s a trumpet player, sax, cello, contrabass, piano and drums. I think I finally just put something up there in nice broad strokes. And I’m making a few bobbles and a few clams here and there, but basically it says to me you’ve finally gotten yourself inside of that horn, you finally are connecting with…
You must hold yourself to a pretty high standard I think if you feel in ‘97 you are finally happy with or pleased—
